audit_report.scope: Full-stack code audit: 123+ source files read, frontend-backend API consistency verified
audit_report.verdict: ISSUE.md is mostly accurate (52/56 verified). 2 false positives (M8 partially, M14). 1 new bug found: AdminPluginsPage references non-existent `description` field. 3 bugs have title/description mismatches (H2, H7, H14). Overall report quality is high with strong coverage.

false_positives_found_in_issue_md.title: DRF异常处理无法处理列表形式 response.data
false_positives_found_in_issue_md.analysis: The ISSUE claims `response.data.get('detail')` returns `None` for list-type errors, causing crashes. In reality, DRF's `ValidationError` responses are wrapped by `exception_handler` which returns `{'detail': <string>}` for non-field errors and `{field: <list>}` for field errors. The `.get('detail')` call returns `None` for field errors, but the code falls back to `str(exc)`, which is functional. This is a robustness concern, not a crash bug.
false_positives_found_in_issue_md.verdict: PARTIAL_FALSE_POSITIVE — Won't crash, but error messages are suboptimal for field validation errors

false_positives_found_in_issue_md.title: FormData布尔值以字符串格式传递
false_positives_found_in_issue_md.analysis: ISSUE claims `formData.append('sync_to_profile', true)` sends string `"true"` which DRF can't parse. However, DRF's `BooleanField` natively handles `'true'`/`'false'` (case-insensitive) string representations. The backend checks `serializer.validated_data.get('sync_to_profile', False)` which correctly resolves to Python `True`. No functional bug.
false_positives_found_in_issue_md.verdict: FALSE_POSITIVE — DRF BooleanField correctly parses 'true'/'false' strings

missed_bugs_found.title: AdminPluginsPage references non-existent `description` field
missed_bugs_found.analysis: AdminPluginsPage.vue line 77 renders `{{ plugin.description || '暂无描述' }}`. However, the `Plugin` model (plugins/models.py) has no `description` field — only `name`, `type`, `is_active`, `config`, `created_at`. The `AdminPluginListView` (admin_dashboard/views.py:185-193) returns only these fields. Result: `plugin.description` is always `undefined`, displaying "暂无描述" for all plugins.
missed_bugs_found.remediation: Add `description` field to Plugin model and include it in AdminPluginListView, or remove the template reference

missed_bugs_found.title: AdminGroupPostsView and AdminLogsView lack int() validation (C4 extension)
missed_bugs_found.analysis: Two additional int() locations not flagged individually in ISSUE.md's C4 list (though C4 references '10+ locations' broadly). These are part of the 11 total locations. Already covered by C4's umbrella.
